entries.note: Google's Default Media Receiver (app id CC1AD845) plays H.264 up to 1080p with stereo AAC and no HDR on every Cast device, per Google's published Cast supported-media table. A sender casting to it declares client chromecast-default-receiver; this entry resolves that receiver (ADR-0194 section 6) and pins the floor so no route exceeds it. Per-model receivers need their own selectors and custom receiver (CORE-2567).
